card: Create Tracker Ticket from Issue | v1 | Adds a Create ticket button to the issue header that opens the tracker, fills its Create issue form with the issue title, body, link and labels, and then shows a link to the new ticket. | WHAT IT WILL DO | Add a 'Create ticket' button to the issue header's actions bar (DOM; no network ops were captured). | When clicked, read the issue title, first comment body, labels and URL from the page. | Open or reuse the tracker tab at localhost:8806 and fill Summary (title), Description (body plus a link back to the issue) and Labels. | Click the tracker's Create button once, saving a checkpoint first so a page reload never re-submits. | Confirm the new ticket page shows the summary, then read the ticket id and URL from it. | Show a link to the new ticket next to the button and remember it for this issue. | Sites: 127.0.0.1/fixture-issues | Also acts on other sites: | localhost/fixture-tracker — tracker-sink (createTicket) | Show progress messages in this panel | Remember its own settings in this browser | Open and act on the other sites listed below, using your login there (Phase F) | Needs your confirmation at runtime: Creates a ticket in the tracker at http://localhost:8806/fixture-tracker/ (clicks its Create button) | Approve & install | Modify | Reject
